staging.note: While enabled the build uses the staging domain, emits noindex,nofollow on every page, serves a Disallow-all robots.txt, and shows a banner. This is the ONE case where noindex is correct: a reachable copy of the site that Google indexes is duplicate content competing with the real thing. Set enabled:false at go-live and the site returns to fully indexable with the production domain. If the staging domain includes a path (a GitHub Pages project site such as https://user.github.io/repo), the build detects it, rewrites every root-relative link to sit under that path, and skips the CNAME file. Swap this to a real subdomain like https://new.bluestonesbpo.com once DNS exists and the rewriting turns itself off.

editorial.author_bio: Bluestones BPO's Seoul-based accounting, payroll and compliance team writes these notes for foreign companies operating in Korea. Every figure, rate, threshold and deadline is checked against the primary source — the National Tax Service, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the four major insurance authorities, the Korea Immigration Service or the relevant statute — and dated to the period it covers. Guidance here is general; it is not a substitute for engagement-specific advice.
